scope: Explicit missing Compendium.ptu targets in declared pack source strings; field-level classification, not proof of rules correctness.

import-provenance.consumer: Historical core provenance. Core import preparation replaces it with the acquired UUID; the modern-first source accessor can read it on existing/raw documents. Preserve it; do not guess replacements.

legacy-import-provenance.consumer: Legacy provenance is the source accessor fallback when current core identity is absent; refresh and migration consumers still read it. Do not treat it as proven inert.

species-ability.consumer: PokemonGenerator.create resolves ability UUIDs and skips a missing result; evolution/level-up can dereference the result.

species-capability.consumer: PokemonGenerator.create resolves capability UUIDs and skips a missing result.

species-move.consumer: Species sheet resolves linked moves. Level entries are also consumed by generator and level-up workflows; this does not imply machine/tutor generator coverage.

temporary-species.consumer: TemporarySpecies constructor reads fromUuidSync(uuid).system; a missing result can throw and the rule factory drops the failed rule.
